heading: Binary operator table
text:
### Binary operator table [IRET.9.7]

| DS | Node kind | Operand types |
|---|---|---|
| `+` `-` `*` `/` | BINOP / ARITH | Int×Int→Int, Float×Float→Float, Int×Float→Float |
| `//` `%` | BINOP / INT_ARITH | Int×Int→Int |
| `==` `!=` `<` `>` `<=` `>=` | BINOP / CMP | numeric, String (interned ptr), Bool |
| `and` `or` | BINOP / LOGICAL | Bool×Bool→Bool |
| `&` `\|` `^` `<<` `>>` | BINOP / BITWISE | Int×Int→Int |
| `~` | UNOP / BIT_NOT | Int→Int |
| `not` | UNOP / LOGICAL_NOT | Bool→Bool |
| negate (`-x`) | UNOP / NEGATE | Int→Int, Float→Float |
